meta.subject: Avoid snoop deadlock whith snoops. Adds mrvq not almost full for snrq pop

en.summary: Fixes a cache-bank snoop deadlock by preventing snoop-request dequeue while the miss-reservation queue is stopped or almost full.
why_it_counts: The patch changes central cache-bank arbitration logic in RTL.
The commit message explicitly describes a snoop deadlock fix.
The added condition ties snoop progress to miss-reservation backpressure, which is a correctness requirement for forward progress under coherence traffic.
evidence: VX_bank.v changes snrq_pop from a condition that ignored mrvq_stop to one that requires !mrvq_stop.
In the same file, reqq_pop was already blocked by !mrvq_stop, showing snoop dequeue was the inconsistent queue-arbitration case.
mrvq_stop is wired from the miss-reservation queue stop signal, which is used to throttle bank-side request issue when the miss machinery is near saturation.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A banked coherent cache often has separate queues for ordinary requests, miss-reservation replay, and snoops. If the miss side is stopped because its reservation or response structures are near full, the bank must not keep draining snoops in a way that requires miss-side resources to make forward progress. Allowing snoop dequeue to ignore miss-side backpressure can create a circular wait: snoops advance into a path that depends on structures that are already blocked, and the bank stops making progress.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: snoop dequeue arbitration under miss-side backpressure
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Snoop requests are pending while the miss-reservation or miss-response path is in a stop or almost-full condition.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow snoops to dequeue even when miss-side stop/backpressure is asserted.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop backpressure term from snoop-pop condition
portability_notes: Map this to any coherent cache bank with separate snoop and miss handling queues.
The key bug is not specific to an almost-full threshold; any miss-side condition that should stall snoop issue can be removed to recreate the fault.
If the DUT folds snoops and ordinary requests into one arbiter, remove the dependency that prevents snoops from advancing when miss replay cannot drain.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the arbitration condition that chooses when a snoop request can leave its queue and enter the cache pipeline.
Remove the term that blocks snoop dequeue when the miss-reservation or miss-response side is stopped, almost full, or otherwise backpressured.
Leave the rest of the queue priorities unchanged so the only change is that snoops ignore miss-side stop.
Stress the design with simultaneous snoop traffic and miss pressure to expose a forward-progress failure or deadlock.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_bank queue-pop arbitration for snrq_pop versus mrvq_stop
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds !mrvq_stop to snrq_pop so snoop requests cannot leave the snoop queue while the miss-reservation queue is stopped.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the !mrvq_stop term from snrq_pop while keeping the rest of the arbitration condition intact.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under combined snoop and miss pressure, the cache bank can enter a forward-progress failure or deadlock because snoops advance into a path that the stalled miss machinery cannot service.
evidence_for_injection: The patch is a one-line arbitration fix that only adds the missing miss-side backpressure term to snoop dequeue.
Ordinary request dequeue already respected mrvq_stop, so snoop dequeue was the asymmetrical case.
The commit subject explicitly states the goal is to avoid snoop deadlock.
notes: The duplicated !reqq_pop term in the expression is pre-existing and not the bug fixed here.
If another DUT uses a single combined stop signal with a different name, that is still the correct anchor for this injection.

zh.summary: 该提交通过在 miss-reservation 队列停止或接近满时禁止 snoop request 出队，修复了 cache bank 的 snoop 死锁。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 RTL 中 cache bank 的核心仲裁逻辑。
提交信息明确说明这是一个 snoop deadlock 修复。
新增条件把 snoop 推进与 miss-reservation 反压绑定起来，这是在一致性流量下保证前进性的正确性要求。
evidence: VX_bank.v 把 snrq_pop 从忽略 mrvq_stop 的条件改为必须满足 !mrvq_stop。
同一文件里 reqq_pop 原本就受 !mrvq_stop 限制，说明 snoop 出队是原先仲裁中不一致的一支。
mrvq_stop 来自 miss-reservation queue 的 stop 信号，用于在 miss 结构接近饱和时对 bank 侧请求发射施加节流。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一个带一致性的 banked cache 往往会把普通请求、miss-reservation replay 和 snoop 分到不同队列中。如果 miss 侧因为 reservation 或 response 结构接近满而进入 stop 状态，那么 bank 不能继续让那些仍依赖 miss 侧资源前进的 snoop 一路推进。若 snoop 出队忽略 miss 侧反压，就可能形成环形等待：snoop 前进到了一个依赖已阻塞结构的路径里，整个 bank 失去前进性。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: miss 侧反压下的 snoop 出队仲裁
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 存在待处理 snoop 请求，同时 miss-reservation 或 miss-response 路径处于 stop/接近满状态。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 即使 miss 侧 stop/反压已经拉起，也继续允许 snoop 出队。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从 snoop-pop 条件中删除反压项
portability_notes: 将它映射到任何把 snoop 处理和 miss 处理分开的 coherent cache bank。
关键缺陷并不依赖“almost full”这个具体阈值；只要移除本应阻止 snoop 发射的 miss 侧停顿条件，就能复现此类问题。
如果 DUT 把 snoop 与普通请求折叠在同一个仲裁器里，就删除“当 miss replay 无法排空时禁止 snoop 前进”的那条依赖。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到控制 snoop 请求何时能离开队列进入缓存流水线的仲裁条件。
删除其中在 miss-reservation 或 miss-response 一侧 stop、接近满或被反压时阻止 snoop 出队的项。
保持其他队列优先级不变，使唯一变化是 snoop 不再尊重 miss 侧 stop。
在 snoop 流量和 miss 压力并发的情况下施压，以暴露前进性故障或死锁。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_bank 中 snrq_pop 与 mrvq_stop 的队列出队仲裁
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 snrq_pop 中新增 !mrvq_stop，使 snoop 请求在 miss-reservation queue 停止时不能离开 snoop queue。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 从 snrq_pop 中删除 !mrvq_stop，同时保持其余仲裁条件不变。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 snoop 和 miss 压力并发时，cache bank 可能发生前进性失败或死锁，因为 snoop 被推进到了一个停滞的 miss 处理路径上。
evidence_for_injection: 这个补丁是一行仲裁修复，仅为 snoop 出队补上了缺失的 miss 侧反压项。
普通请求出队原本已经遵守 mrvq_stop，因此 snoop 出队是原先不对称的一支。
提交标题直接说明目标是避免 snoop deadlock。
notes: 表达式中重复的 !reqq_pop 是原有写法，不是本次修复的目标。
如果另一 DUT 使用不同名字的统一 stop 信号，也应把它当作该注入的正确锚点。
